input_question: How many active users do we have?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = 1;

input_question: What is the total revenue for the last 30 days?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days';

input_question: List the top 5 products by total sales.
expect_expected_sql: SELECT p.name SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5;
expect_guidelines: Use approved tables only. Always limit ranking queries.

input_question: What is the average order value by month this year?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month' order_date) AS month AVG(amount) AS avg_value FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

input_question: How many new users signed up each day last week?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day COUNT(*) AS signups FROM users WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

input_question: Which customers have not placed an order in the last 90 days?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT u.id u.email FROM users u WHERE u.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days');

input_question: What is the conversion rate from signups to first purchase?
expect_expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id)::float / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS conversion_rate FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

input_question: Show monthly revenue growth compared to the previous month.
expect_expected_sql: SELECT month revenue revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS growth FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month' order_date) AS month SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY month) t;
